paragraphs.marker: zwei an direkt benachbarten Kohlenstoffatomen gebundene Reste R7
paragraphs.zh: zwei an direkt benachbarten Kohlenstoffatomen gebundene Reste R7 bilden eine Bindung oder bilden mit dem sie tragenden Kohlenstoffatomen einen gegebenenfalls durch ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Reste aus der Gruppe Halogen, Alkyl,  Alkylthio und Alkoxy substituierten 3- bis 6-gliedrigen Ring;
paragraphs.en: two R7 radicals bonded to directly adjacent carbon atoms form a bond, or together with the carbon atoms carrying them form a 3- to 6-membered ring which is optionally substituted by one or more identical or different radicals from the group consisting of halogen, alkyl, alkylthio and alkoxy;
paragraphs.notes: The zh field holds the verbatim German; this is a German-language WO publication and not Chinese. The superscript 7 on R is printed as a superscript and is rendered inline here. This sentence is the tail of the R7 definition that begins on the preceding page, so the page opens mid-list with no marker of its own. Printed as 'mit dem sie tragenden Kohlenstoffatomen' - the dative singular article 'dem' with a plural noun is as printed and is not corrected here. The double space after 'Alkyl,' is as printed. A small stray ink squiggle sits just above 'gegebenenfalls' at the end of the second line; it is a scan artifact, not a character.

paragraphs.zh: R8 und R9    unabhängig voneinander Alkyl, Alkenyl, Alkinyl, Halogenalkyl, gegebenenfalls substituiertes Aryl oder gegebenenfalls substituiertes Arylalkyl;
paragraphs.en: R8 and R9    independently of one another alkyl, alkenyl, alkynyl, haloalkyl, optionally substituted aryl or optionally substituted arylalkyl;
paragraphs.notes: Superscripts 8 and 9 on R. This is the narrower 'bevorzugt' definition: unlike the broad R8/R9 definition on printed page 18 it lists only Halogenalkyl, without Halogenalkenyl and Halogenalkinyl. German '-alkinyl' is rendered '-alkynyl' in English.

paragraphs.zh: R12    Wasserstoff, Halogenalkyl, Alkoxyalkyl, Formyl, Alkylcarbonyl, Alkoxycarbonyl, Alkylsulfonyl, Halogenalkylsulfonyl, Benzoyl oder Phenylsulfonyl, wobei die beiden letztgenannten Gruppen gegebenenfalls durch ein oder mehrere, gleiche oder verschiedene Reste aus der Gruppe Alkyl, Halogenalkyl, Alkoxy, Halogenalkoxy, Halogen, Cyano und Nitro substituiert sind;
paragraphs.en: R12    hydrogen, haloalkyl, alkoxyalkyl, formyl, alkylcarbonyl, alkoxycarbonyl, alkylsulfonyl, haloalkylsulfonyl, benzoyl or phenylsulfonyl, where the two last-mentioned groups are optionally substituted by one or more identical or different radicals from the group consisting of alkyl, haloalkyl, alkoxy, haloalkoxy, halogen, cyano and nitro;
paragraphs.notes: Superscript 12 on R. In the second occurrence of 'Halogenalkyl' (the one in the list 'Gruppe Alkyl, Halogenalkyl, Alkoxy') the ascender of the 'l' is broken in the scan, so the word reads as 'Halogenaikyl' glyph by glyph; it is transcribed as 'Halogenalkyl' because the stroke is a degraded 'l' and no such word as 'Halogenaikyl' exists. 'die beiden letztgenannten Gruppen' refers to Benzoyl and Phenylsulfonyl.

paragraphs.zh: L    eine gegebenenfalls durch ein bis vier gleiche oder verschiedene Reste R2 substituierte C1-C6-Alkylenkette;
paragraphs.en: L    a C1-C6 alkylene chain optionally substituted by one to four identical or different radicals R2;
paragraphs.notes: Superscript 2 on R; the 1 and 6 in C1-C6 are printed as subscripts.

paragraphs.zh: Y    eine divalente Einheit aus der Gruppe O, N-H, N-Alkyl, CHR7 oder C(R7)2;
paragraphs.en: Y    a divalent unit from the group consisting of O, N-H, N-alkyl, CHR7 or C(R7)2;
paragraphs.notes: Superscript 7 on both occurrences of R; the 2 in C(R7)2 is printed as a subscript. The terminating semicolon is printed low and small next to the subscript 2.

paragraphs.zh: Z    eine direkte Bindung, eine divalente Einheit aus der Gruppe O, S, SO2, N-Alkyl, CHR7 oder C(R7)2 und
paragraphs.en: Z    a direct bond, a divalent unit from the group consisting of O, S, SO2, N-alkyl, CHR7 or C(R7)2 and
paragraphs.notes: The 2 of SO2 and the 2 of C(R7)2 are printed as subscripts; the 7 on R is a superscript. Unlike Y, the Z list also offers a direct bond and S and SO2.
'bedeuten' closes the preferred-embodiment definition list that began on an earlier page ('worin ... bedeuten' = 'in which ... are').

paragraphs.zh: Besonders bevorzugt sind Verbindungen der allgemeinen Formel (I), worin
paragraphs.en: Particularly preferred are compounds of the general formula (I) in which
paragraphs.notes: Opens a third, still narrower Markush definition list for formula (I): 'bevorzugt' on the earlier page, 'besonders bevorzugt' here.

paragraphs.zh: R1    Halogen-(C1-C6)-alkoxy, Halogen-(C2-C6)-alkenyloxy, Halogen-(C3-C6)-alkinyloxy, Halogen-(C1-C6)-alkylthio, Halogen-(C2-C6)-alkenylthio, Halogen-(C3-C6)-alkinylthio, Halogen-(C1-C6)-alkylamino, Halogen-(C2-C6)-alkenylamino, Halogen-(C3-C6)-alkinylamino, Halogen-(C1-C6)-alkylsulfonyl, Halogen-(C2-C6)-alkenylsulfonyl, Halogen-(C3-C6)-alkinylsulfonyl, Halogen-(C1-C6)-alkylsulfinyl, Halogen-(C2-C6)-alkenylsulfinyl, Halogen-(C3-C6)-alkinylsulfinyl, Halogen-(C1-C6)-alkylcarbonyl,
paragraphs.en: R1    halo-(C1-C6)-alkoxy, halo-(C2-C6)-alkenyloxy, halo-(C3-C6)-alkynyloxy, halo-(C1-C6)-alkylthio, halo-(C2-C6)-alkenylthio, halo-(C3-C6)-alkynylthio, halo-(C1-C6)-alkylamino, halo-(C2-C6)-alkenylamino, halo-(C3-C6)-alkynylamino, halo-(C1-C6)-alkylsulfonyl, halo-(C2-C6)-alkenylsulfonyl, halo-(C3-C6)-alkynylsulfonyl, halo-(C1-C6)-alkylsulfinyl, halo-(C2-C6)-alkenylsulfinyl, halo-(C3-C6)-alkynylsulfinyl, halo-(C1-C6)-alkylcarbonyl,
paragraphs.notes: Superscript 1 on R; every C-count digit inside the parentheses is printed as a subscript. The segment after 'Halogen-' is printed lowercase throughout ('-alkoxy', '-alkenyloxy'), as transcribed. The list runs off the foot of the page unterminated, ending with a comma after 'Halogen-(C1-C6)-alkylcarbonyl,'; it continues on the next page. German '-alkinyl-' is rendered '-alkynyl-' in English and the prefix 'Halogen-' is rendered 'halo-'.
